notes: The grader is the spec. Deterministic (code-graded) evals run via `python evals/run_evals.py` and are gated in CI by the unittest suite. Model-graded evals — trigger discovery (t*) and proposal quality (a9) — need a judge with the SAME context the system sees, must reason before scoring, use a confidence threshold, and run over multiple trials at iteration time (report the distribution, not just a mean). They are NOT part of the dependency-free CI gate.

trigger_evals.prompt: Look at my ~/.claude history and turn my repeated workflows into skills and hooks.
What do I keep doing over and over in Claude Code? Automate it.
Mine my session transcripts for patterns I could turn into a skill.
Build me a skill for reviewing PRs.
trigger_evals.why: authoring one specific skill from scratch — that is writing-skills/skill-creator, not retroactive mining

trigger_evals.prompt: Write a hook that blocks force-push.
trigger_evals.why: single known hook, no mining of history needed

trigger_evals.prompt: Summarize what I did yesterday in Claude.

trigger_grader.method: Present the skill's `description` (the exact text injected into the system prompt — the body is NOT visible at trigger time) plus the prompt to a fresh classifier that must REASON before deciding, then assert its load decision equals should_trigger.
trigger_grader.report: pass@k per case WITH the full distribution — not just a mean; hard negatives t4–t7 must NOT trigger on any trial
trigger_grader.pass_threshold: 7/7 cases correct at the chosen k
trigger_grader.when: iteration time (needs a judge); not the dependency-free CI unit gate

application_evals.name: Scorer objectivity: domain-agnostic + noise-aware (WS3 hard negatives)
checks: harness-orchestration sequences (Task/SendMessage) flagged harness_noise + not promoted to skill-chain
research/report loops (WebSearch/WebFetch/Read) not treated as navigation noise
a non-dev recurring command (terraform plan) reaches the guardrail/hook tier structurally, with no dev-CI verb
leverage = frequency x steps_saved surfaced; research outranks harness noise (leverage-forward ranking)

application_evals.name: Map-reduce determinism: shard (striped split) + merge (cross-shard dedup/rank)
checks: shard splits the top-N leverage-ranked shortlist STRIPED (each shard a representative cross-section, not a contiguous score block), stable by cand id
shard carries the dedup baseline (existing_automations) + env to each worker
merge collapses cross-shard duplicates on dedup_key, keeps the strongest representative, unions proofs
merge ranks by score, caps to --limit finalists, and is byte-deterministic

application_evals.name: Guardrail proof-bar shipped (head/tail regression, deterministic half)
application_evals.note: Pins the mitigation in place: the proof-bar text (forbid asserting an environment fact absent from the proof; the named head/tail 'exit 127' example) must stay shipped in references/scoring-rubric.md AND agents/analyzer.md. The BEHAVIOURAL half is model-graded — see a14.

application_evals.name: head/tail guardrail cannot recur (behavioural)
application_evals.rubric: Run an analyzer worker on a shard containing a bare Bash error->Bash guardrail candidate whose proof transcript does NOT show any exit code or failure of head/tail. Assert the worker's proposal (if any) states ONLY the observed pattern and asserts NO environment fact absent from the proof (no 'exit 127', no 'command fails/unsupported'). A proposal that invents a failure mode fails.
application_evals.report: mean + full distribution; pass if no run invents an environment fact
context_required: a shard-NN.json with the guardrail candidate
a proof transcript with no head/tail failure
application_evals.when: iteration time (needs a judge + a worker run); not the CI unit gate

application_evals.name: Durable index: incremental, crash-safe, remembering scan (WS4)
checks: SQLite change detection is size-primary + OneDrive-mtime-drift immune (prefix-hash tiebreak)
unchanged files skipped; appends folded via byte-offset resume; deleted files pruned
per-session commit leaves crash-safe partial progress; corrupt db -> .db.bak + rebuild; schema bump -> discard + rescan
verdict ledger merges (remember) and a re-scan surfaces the prior verdict with evidence_unchanged

application_evals.name: Self-reviewing compile shipped (WS5, deterministic half)
checks: author (agents/compiler.md) and independent reviewer (agents/reviewer.md) both ship, pinned model: sonnet
reviewer never grades its own draft (independence stated)
bundled references/skill-quality-rubric.md ships the Triggerability/Grounding/confidence bars
the deterministic validator floor flags a workflow-summary description (weak) and passes a clean one (strong)

application_evals.name: Compile review loop rejects a weak draft, passes a strong one (behavioural)
application_evals.rubric: Give the reviewer subagent (agents/reviewer.md + references/skill-quality-rubric.md) two drafts of the same proposal: (weak) description summarises the workflow and a step cites no proof; (strong) trigger-only description, every step grounded in a proof path. Assert the reviewer FAILS the weak draft with specific fixes and PASSES the strong one. The author must never be the grader.
application_evals.report: mean + full distribution; pass if weak fails and strong passes on every run
application_evals.when: iteration time (needs a judge running the reviewer); not the CI unit gate

application_evals.name: Real-data read-only smoke produces valid proof paths
application_evals.pass_if: scan.json written; every candidate has >=1 proof_path whose file exists; no writes under skills/
application_evals.when: manual / local (needs a real ~/.claude); not in the CI gate

application_evals.name: Proposal quality (analyzer verdict)
application_evals.rubric: Given scan.json + the emitted verdict.json, score 1-5: (a) are proposals genuinely repeated workflows, not exploration noise? (b) is each primitive choice defensible per primitive-selection.md? (c) does every proposal carry a real proof path? (d) are already-automated candidates dropped? Judge must reason before scoring.
application_evals.trials: >=5 analyzer runs on the fixture scan.json
application_evals.report: mean + full distribution (no mean without a distribution); pass at mean>=4 AND no run below 3
application_evals.when: iteration time (needs a judge + a generated verdict.json); not the CI unit gate

deterministic_gate.note: Runs every application eval marked in_runner (a1–a8) and reports a pass/fail table. Exit 0 == gate green. The unittest suite in CI covers the same checks.

red_green_gate.scenario: Look at my ~/.claude history and turn my repeated workflows into skills/hooks.
red_green_gate.red: A fresh agent WITHOUT groundhog (see references/red-baseline.md).
red_green_gate.green: The same scenario WITH groundhog succeeds end-to-end: bounded scan, ranked deduped proposals with proof paths, valid emitted artifacts, secrets scrubbed (best-effort), managed-hook policy respected, no writes without approval.
